# Purchase ringi: the longest a ticket takes

File: `purchase.ringi` (the request `purchase`, version 1, sha256:48295fa0db92fbbd).

Kept by the team General Affairs (`general_affairs`).

The organization is read in each of its versions: from 2026-04-01 and 2027-04-01.

## The longest a ticket takes

A ticket of this request ends within 246 business days at the most:

| What | Business days |
|---|---|
| The longest path of the route, 4 times: once, and again each time it is sent back | 4 × 54 |
| With the requester, to submit it again, 3 times | 3 × 10 |
| In all | 246 |

## The longest path

Every stage comes, those with a condition too.

| Stage | Who answers | Deadline | When it is late | Business days at the most |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| first | manager | 5 business days, at the end of the day | goes up to the head above, then expires | 11 |
| technical | reviewer | 5 business days, at the end of the day | goes up to the head above, then expires | 11 |
| finance | finance | 5 business days, at the end of the day | goes up to the head above, then expires | 11 |
| board | at least 60% of board | 10 business days, at the end of the day | expires | 10 |
| decide | the one the rule `authority` names in `decider` (dept_head, division_head or president) | 5 business days, at the end of the day | goes up to the head above, then expires | 11 |

One round of this path takes 54 business days at the most.

From 2026-04-03 (Fri) to 2027-02-26 (Fri): 231 business days.

> No ticket takes longer than 246 business days, whatever the days the calendar closes; a ticket that takes all of them need not be there. On these dates it takes fewer: where a deadline at the end of a day runs out on the eve of a day the calendar closes, the stage goes up on the closed day, which is not a business day, and so takes one business day less.

## What shortens it

Each row changes one thing of the request, and says what the longest becomes, counted the same way: where another path becomes the longest, it is counted on that path.

| Change | The longest becomes | Shorter by |
|---|---|---|
| Every stage due in 4 business days instead of 5 business days | 214 | 32 |
| The stage “board” due in 9 business days instead of 10 business days | 242 | 4 |
| Sent back at most 2 times instead of 3 times | 182 | 64 |
| Submitted again within 9 business days instead of 10 business days | 243 | 3 |
